name: Victorian Landcare Grants (Melbourne Water region)

funder.name: Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action (DEECA), Victorian Government

summary: Annual Victorian Government grants for community-led Landcare, Friends, Coastcare and Aboriginal groups doing on-ground work to protect and restore native vegetation, fauna, waterways, wetlands and soils in the Port Phillip and Westernport region. Project grants reach AUD 20,000.

geography.label: Port Phillip and Westernport region, Victoria

amount.note: Project grants; support grants are up to AUD 500

status.quote: The 2026 Victorian Government Landcare Grants round is now closed.
The next round is expected to be announced in early 2027.

administered_by.quote: Melbourne Water now administers the program for the Port Phillip and Westernport region, following the integration of the CMA in 2022.

applicant_types.quote: Victorian Landcare or environmental volunteer group/network that is community-led and has a focus on on-ground land and natural environment improvement work. This includes: Landcare groups/networks Friends of groups Conservation Management Networks Coastcare Victoria groups Committees of management Aboriginal groups/organisations working on Country

geography.quote: Melbourne Water now administers the program for the Port Phillip and Westernport region, following the integration of the CMA in 2022.

access.quote: For further details on eligibility and how to apply, download the guidelines on this page.

window.quote: The 2026 Victorian Government Landcare Grants round is now closed. The next round is expected to be announced in early 2027.

amount.quote: Project Grants of up to $20,000 are available for on-ground works, community education and engagement, and group/network development activities that protect or improve natural assets such as native vegetation, native fauna, waterways, wetlands and soils.
